unreachable.title: We couldn't reach SparkCircles
unreachable.caption: Check your connection and try again.

welcome.tagline: Organize family life with families near you.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: It takes 2 minutes. You can add more about your family later.
signUp.lastNameHelper: Others only see the first letter.
signUp.passwordHelper: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
signUp.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>
signUp.termsPlain: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy
signUp.marketing: Send me news and ideas from SparkCircles

fieldErrors.email: Check your email address, it looks incomplete.
fieldErrors.password: Use at least 10 characters, and avoid common passwords like 'motdepasse123'.
fieldErrors.adult: Tick this box to confirm you're 18 or older. SparkCircles is for adults only.
fieldErrors.terms: Tick this box to accept the terms and privacy policy.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Tap it within 24 hours to confirm your email.
checkInbox.bodyNoEmail: We've sent you a link. Tap it within 24 hours to confirm your email.
checkInbox.resent: New link sent. You can ask again in a moment.
checkInbox.helpBody: Look in your spam folder. Unconfirmed accounts are deleted after 7 days.

linkExpired.title: This link has expired
linkExpired.body: Links work for a limited time and only once. We'll send you a fresh one.

logIn.title: Log in
logIn.lockedCaption: Try again in 15 minutes, or reset your password.
logIn.securedTitle: Your account is locked for your security
logIn.securedCaption: After the email change report, our team needs to check your account. We'll email you a link to choose a new password. Waiting won't unlock it.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link.

linkSent.title: Check your inbox
linkSent.body: If an account exists for this email, we've sent you a link. It works for 1 hour.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.caption: You'll be logged out on your other devices.

closure.title: Your account is closing
closure.body: Your personal data will be erased on {{date}}. Until then, you can keep your account as it was.
closure.restored: Welcome back. Your account is active again.

emailChange.takenBody: This address can't be used for your account. Your email hasn't changed: you still log in with your current address.

report.securedBody: We've logged you out on every device and locked your account. Our team will check the email change. Then we'll email you a link to choose a new password.
report.expiredBody: For your security, this link only works for 30 days after an email change, and it can't be sent again.
report.securedCaption: You don't need to do anything else for now.
report.alreadyBody: This report is recorded and your account is locked. Our team will email you a link to choose a new password once it's checked.
report.expiredHelp: If you think someone else changed your email, contact the SparkCircles team.

rateLimited.title: Too many tries for now
rateLimited.logIn: Wait a few minutes, then try again.
rateLimited.signUp: Wait a few minutes, then try again. What you typed is kept.
rateLimited.forgotPassword: Wait a few minutes, then try again. If you've already asked, look in your inbox and spam folder.
rateLimited.resend: You've asked for several links. Wait a few minutes before asking again, and look in your spam folder.
rateLimited.wait: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

account.title: My account
account.data: Get a copy of my data

badge.verifiedA11y: Verified, identity checked by SparkCircles. Opens an explanation.

verificationCard.notVerifiedTitle: Verify your identity to host events
verificationCard.notVerifiedBody: Joining events never needs it. About 3 minutes. Our team reviews your documents within 48 hours.
verificationCard.pendingBody: Usually within 48 hours. We'll let you know.
verificationCard.expiresSoonBody: Verify again with a valid document to keep hosting.
verificationCard.expiredBody: Others now see you as not verified. Verify again to host events.

profilePreview.title: How others see me
profilePreview.intro: This is exactly what other members see.
profilePreview.neverShownBody: Full last name, email, date of birth, identity document and selfie.

badgeSheet.verifiedBody: We checked an official ID and a selfie of this person.
badgeSheet.match: Their name and face match an official ID
badgeSheet.notCriminal: This is not a criminal record check
badgeSheet.judgment: Always trust your own judgment with your children.
badgeSheet.notVerifiedBody: This person hasn't checked their identity with SparkCircles. They can join events open to everyone, but can't host.

editProfile.title: Edit your profile
editProfile.city: City or neighborhood shown to others
editProfile.cityHelper: Optional. Leave empty to hide it.
editProfile.nameSheetBody: Your Verified badge will be removed. You'll need to verify again before hosting new events.

changeEmail.title: Change your email
changeEmail.intro: We'll send a link to your new address. Your current email keeps working until you confirm.
changeEmail.sentBody: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Tap it to confirm your new email. We've also told your current address about this change.

security.title: Password and devices
security.sheetBody: You'll need to log in again on every device, including this one.

dataExport.title: Get a copy of your data
dataExport.body: You'll get a file with your account, profile, consents, history and verification outcome. Usually within 48 hours, 30 days at most.
dataExport.requestedOn: Requested on {{date}}. We'll send you a notification and an email.

closeAccount.title: Close your account
closeAccount.hidden: Your profile disappears for others right away.
closeAccount.loggedOut: You're logged out on all your devices.
closeAccount.erased: Your personal data is erased in {{days}} days.
closeAccount.recover: Until then, log in to keep your account. After that, nothing can be recovered.

accountClosed.title: Your account is closed
accountClosed.body: We've sent you an email. Your data will be erased on {{date}}. Changed your mind? Log in before then.

gate.title: Verify your identity to host
gate.body: Verified hosts keep children safe. Joining events never needs it.
gate.needDocument: A valid passport, ID card, driving licence or residence permit
gate.needTime: About 3 minutes. Our team reviews your documents within 48 hours.
gate.privacy: Your photos are only seen by our team and erased within 30 days of the decision.
gate.pendingBody: Usually within 48 hours. You'll be able to host as soon as you're verified.

document.title: Which document do you have?
document.hint: Your document must not be expired.
document.residencePermitCaption: Titre de séjour, front and back

capture.intro: Place it flat, inside the frame.
capture.cameraDenied: SparkCircles needs your camera to take the photo
capture.failedCaption: Try again, or choose one from your photos.

review.title: Last step
review.failedCaption: Check your connection and try again.
review.photosRejectedCaption: Take the marked photos again, then send them.
review.dobUnderage: You need to be 18 or older to verify your identity.
review.expired: This document has expired. Use a valid one.

status.sentBody: Our team checks every request by hand. We'll send you a notification and an email.
status.stepReviewCaption: You can't host events until it's done
status.renewalBody: You stay verified while our team checks your new document. Usually within 48 hours.
status.renewalReviewCaption: You can keep hosting events meanwhile

area.sheetTitle: Where do you look for outings?
area.sheetBody: Choose one or more arrondissements, or all of Paris. We never use your location, and you can change it any time.

empty.nearbyBody: Widen your area, or create the first outing for families nearby.
empty.filteredBody: Remove a filter or widen your area. Or host the first one yourself.

badge.verifiedA11y: Verified, identity checked by SparkCircles. Opens an explanation.

detail.lockNote: The exact address is sent to you as soon as you join.
detail.exactCaption: Exact address, only you and the host see it.
detail.hostExactCaption: Others see only “{{area}}” until they join.
detail.takenHidden_one: {{count}} place taken. Names are shown once you join.
detail.takenHidden_other: {{count}} places taken. Names are shown once you join.
detail.ownParty: Your own party doesn't use places.
detail.joinCaption: Free. You choose how many places you need.
detail.fullCaption: No places left. Look at other events.
detail.verifiedOnlyCaption: This event is open to verified members only.
detail.restrictedTitle: This event is for verified members
detail.restrictedBody: Verify your identity to take part. It takes about 3 minutes.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have ended or been removed.
detail.offlineBody: You can still read this page, last updated {{time}}. Changes need a connection.
detail.draftCaption: Not published yet: only you can see this draft.
detail.cancelBody_one: The participant is told by email. You can't put it back online or change its date: you'd create a new event.
detail.cancelBody_other: The {{count}} participants are told by email. You can't put it back online or change its date: you'd create a new event.
detail.cancelBodyNone: You can't put it back online or change its date: you'd create a new event.
detail.deleteBody: It is deleted for good. Nobody is notified.
detail.leaveBody: Your places are freed right away and you'll lose the exact address.
detail.onHoldBody: No new participants can join for now. We'll tell you if it resumes or is cancelled.
detail.notOpenCaption: Come back later: it may restart.
detail.cancelledBody: The host cancelled it. Your places are released and the exact address is no longer shown.
detail.hostOnHoldBody: Your identity is no longer verified, so nobody can join. Verify again before the event starts to restart it.
detail.hostOnHoldCaption: Editing is paused. If the event starts first, it is cancelled.
detail.hostCancelledBody: The participants were told by email. To meet again, create a new event.

join.title: How many places?
join.body: One place is one person who comes, adult or child. No names to enter.
join.raceBody_one: Only 1 place is left. We adjusted your choice: check it and confirm.
join.raceBody_other: Only {{count}} places are left. We adjusted your choice: check it and confirm.
join.fullBody: Someone took the last places a moment ago. Nothing was booked for you.
join.offlineBody: Your choice is kept. Check your connection and confirm again.

report.body: Tell us what worries you. The host won't know who reported.
report.receivedBody: Our team will look at it. The host isn't told who reported.

form.title: Title
form.dateError: Choose a day that hasn't passed.
form.timeError: The end must be after the start.
form.areaHelper: Everyone sees this area, never the exact address.
form.addressHelper: Only you and the people who join see it. Never filled in for you. You can host at home.
form.placesHelper: Doesn't count you and your own family. From 1 to 100.
form.placesBelowTaken: {{count}} places are already taken: enter {{count}} or more.
form.joinRuleHelper: Can't be changed after you publish. Every SparkCircles member can find the event.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What will you do? What should people bring?
form.ageError: The first age must be lower.
form.tagsHelper: Up to 5 tags. Letters, digits and hyphens, no spaces. No names of people, especially children.
form.tagInvalid: Use letters, digits and hyphens only, with no spaces.
form.tagContact: Tags can't contain a link, an email, a phone number, an @ handle or an address.
form.tagBanned: This word isn't allowed in tags. Choose another one.
form.fillRequired: Fill in the required fields to publish.
form.publishBody: Every SparkCircles member will be able to find it. After publishing you can't change who can join.
form.notifyBody: They'll get an email about this change and can leave in one tap.
form.draftStaysBody: Your identity is no longer verified. Verify it again to publish.
form.notEditable: This event can't be changed any more.
form.keptCaption: What you typed is kept. Check your connection and try again.
form.timeRequired: Choose the start and end times.

mine.emptyBody: Join an event or create your own.

language.helper: Others will see your event exactly as you write it.
